name: Zarządzanie wersjami jądra
description: Lists installed Linux kernels (unprivileged, read-only) and removes old ones via the privileged broker, which independently re-derives and locks the running and latest-installed kernel — never trusts the sidecar or frontend on that. Removal applies where old kernels accumulate (apt and dnf systems); on Arch-based systems and openSUSE the list is shown with the reason there is nothing to remove
